Both responses are accurate. Neither misstates dates, the 30-minute acceptance window, the 24/48-hour reminder option, or the Android known issue. Both also appear to run slightly over the 120-word limit, with Response A at roughly 127 words and Response B in a similar range.

Response B is more complete on the points a manager needs. It lists the specific fixes, including the large-invoice printing error, whereas Response A reduces the fixes to "several bugs" and mentions only one. Response B's labelled sections also make it easier to scan quickly. Response A reads smoothly as prose and is well organised, but it is no shorter and omits a fix.

Verdict: B
